title: U.S. House · Texas's 2nd District
area: Harris and Montgomery counties, including The Woodlands and parts of northeast Houston

context.text: State Representative Steve Toth defeated incumbent U.S. Representative Dan Crenshaw in the March 3, 2026 Republican primary, 55.8% to 40.7%. Crenshaw is not on the November general-election ballot.

candidates.name: Shaun Finnie
candidates.ballotNote: Won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed

summary.text: Shaun Finnie is a former investment banker running as the Democratic nominee for Texas's 2nd Congressional District.

background.text: Earned a bachelor's degree in economics from the University of Saskatchewan, a law degree from the University of Western Ontario, and an MBA in finance and accounting from Northwestern University.
Worked as an oil and gas lawyer for three years, then spent roughly 30 years in investment banking focused on energy mergers and acquisitions.
Served on the Board of Trustees of The John Cooper School and founded an investment club for high school students in The Woodlands.

priorities.text: Says he supports eliminating tariffs he describes as a driver of inflation, raising the minimum wage, and lowering healthcare costs.
Supports expanding the Affordable Care Act, calling it "the most important piece of legislation passed in this century."

positions.summary: Says tariffs are a major driver of inflation and supports getting rid of them.
positions.quote: Tariffs are one of the most obvious drivers of inflation, costing the average American family $2,000–$3,000 a year. I believe in getting rid of harmful tariffs, raising the minimum wage, and lowering healthcare costs so working families have a real opportunity to achieve the American Dream.

positions.summary: Says he supports raising the minimum wage as part of improving affordability.
positions.quote: I believe in getting rid of harmful tariffs, raising the minimum wage, and lowering healthcare costs

positions.summary: Supports expanding the Affordable Care Act and opposes Republican efforts to scale it back.
positions.quote: If we allow Republicans to keep chipping away at the ACA, healthcare will become unaffordable for millions of Americans. I will do everything I can to expand the ACA and make healthcare as accessible and affordable as possible for families across this country.

candidates.name: Steve Toth
candidates.ballotNote: Defeated incumbent U.S. Rep. Dan Crenshaw in the March 3, 2026 Republican primary
candidates.currentRole: Member, Texas House of Representatives (since 2019; also served 2013–2015)

summary.text: Steve Toth is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who defeated incumbent Dan Crenshaw in the Republican primary for Texas's 2nd Congressional District.

background.text: Served in the Texas House of Representatives from 2013 to 2015 and again since 2019.

Worked as an ordained pastor and owned a residential pool service company; earlier career included sales, marketing, and business development roles at companies including Johnson & Johnson and Apple Orthodontix.

priorities.text: Says "family, faith, and freedom are the cornerstones of America" and describes his legislative record as consistently among the most conservative in the Texas House.

candidates.researchNotes: Ballotpedia's curated key messages for Toth focus on general conservative positioning rather than specific policy statements on the issue list; no specific stance quotes on listed issues were found in the sources checked.
